opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round regular grants for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects with a budget under £100,000. No application deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital cost over £1 million.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round major grants for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects with a budget of £100,000 or more. No application deadline; expressions of interest reviewed on a rolling basis.
